prompt: Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck strain after a rear-end collision. The patient had 30 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1466; do not mention it.)
text:
The patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain, stiffness, and intermittent headache radiating to the occupital region. Cervical examination revealed decreased range of motion, particularly in rotation and extension, with paraspinal muscle tenderness and muscle guarding. Neurological screening was within normal limits, with no motor weakness, sensory deficits, or reflex changes in the upper extremities. Cervical imaging obtained at initial evaluation showed no acute fracture or subluxation.

Treatment consisted of a combined program of manual therapy, soft tissue mobilization, therapeutic exercise focused on deep cervical flexor and scapular stabilization, and modalities for pain control as indicated. Over the course of 30 visits, the patient demonstrated gradual improvement in range of motion and a reduction in pain intensity and headache frequency. Home exercise instruction and posture education were reinforced throughout care.

At discharge, the patient reported residual mild stiffness with prolonged computer use but was functioning well in daily activities and work duties. Ongoing self-directed exercise and ergonomic modifications were recommended, with follow-up as needed for any recurrence of symptoms.
